semiconductor_relevance: High — JAINNHER specializes in precision grinding machines essential for wafer processing in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: JAINNHER MACHINE CO., LTD. is a Taiwanese manufacturer of precision grinding machines, offering advanced solutions for wafer material processing. With over 43 years of experience, they provide a range of grinding machines that enhance the accuracy and efficiency of semiconductor manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Internal grinding machines for advanced wafer material processing
Center hole grinding machines for OD grinding accuracy
Double spindle grinding machines for ID, OD, and end face grinding
Vertical grinding machines for large size workpieces

regional_presence.Taiwan: JAINNHER MACHINE is based in Taiwan and has been serving customers globally since its founding.
